name: BokehDiff two-candidate adapter recovery with continuous global RNG
basis: A follows shared synthetic geometry and public BLB input semantics. B is min-max adaptation inspired by the real-image loader, without morphology or GT-dependent operations.
RGB: sRGB PNG8/255 -> 2*RGB-1; no GT-dependent brightness adjustment
model: RealVisXL_V5.0 + author BokehDiff small LoRA and VAE
seed_policy: One global seed before loading each candidate model; one process per candidate; manifest scene order and frames 0..24. Never reset global RNG per frame. Preserve public per-call scheduler generator seeded 42; PISA global rand/dropout advance normally. Separate probes and preflight consume independent streams; do not reuse their PNGs in full runs.
output: Decoder postprocessed float [0,1] -> round(255*x) -> lossless PNG8; never JPEG. Public pre-quantization float is captured without changing forward.
limits: K/10 preserves the public conditioning convention, not a proof of exact rendered blur radius or equivalence to the benchmark renderer.
PISA uses disparity for occlusion as well as defocus magnitude; changing its coordinate range would not be an innocuous CoC-only transformation.
Native PISA divides by 1-d; inspect d=1 behavior and finite output without silently clamping supplied disparity.
Capacity/keyframe checks do not establish full temporal quality or freeze the final adapter.
Synthetic training K_adapt=K*times/max(df,1-df) for GT; K_strength=K*ratio*times for conditioning. K/10 is a declared public input convention, not proven pixel-radius equivalence.
Choosing by this reproduced data/paper profile is protocol reconstruction on development data, not independent benchmark validation or proof of the private author adapter.
Historical seed-0-per-frame outputs are capacity evidence only, excluded from recovery candidates.

normalized.note: Official-style min-max adaptation, NOT exact reproduction of every loader branch. No morphology, inversion, clipping of focus, or K compensation.

selection: Compare absolute discrepancies in the six paper-reported BokehDiff metrics. Freeze only a clear overall result, not highest local score; if metrics conflict retain both and discuss. No continuous K/gamma/seed sweep or third candidate triggered solely by score disagreement.
preflight_order: Manifest order restricted to the same eight scenes, each 0..24; fixed 0/6/12/18/24 reviewed after generation without skipping RNG draws.
boundary_policy: Preserve native PISA arithmetic. Dedicated actual-layer diagnostic records nonfinite sampling coordinates but finite native sampled values, finite attention/decoded RGB and zero occlusion for d=1 source columns on the bounded [0,1] probe. This is a declared native numerical limitation, not proof of all geometry. No clamp or formula/dropout rewrite.
